items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: I like the way they play, like Don Byers, Colvin Hawkins, Tex Bennett

ctx.x: You know, I think there's something psychological about it. On clarinet, the tone is so beautiful and satisfying. You can play the same thing on a saxophone, it doesn't satisfy you. No. The clarinet gives you everything you want. Yes. But the sax, you can play your ass off on it. It just doesn't...

It doesn't stimulate me at all. And I hear somebody else, me and me, you know, I like them. I like the way they play, like Don Byers, Colvin Hawkins, Tex Bennett, who's really mentioned him, and many others that really jam up on that instrument.
